_comment: Cosmetic animation speedups for the owner's own TTR client. factor = speed multiplier (3.0 = 3x faster / ~1/3 the duration). enabled:false leaves a group untouched. Every patch wraps a method and setPlayRate's the track AFTER it starts (setPlayRate-before-start is a no-op). Factors mirror the values that tested well in the open-toontown port. See README / PROJECT-NOTES 'Porting to the live TTR client'.

hud._comment: Street HUD (tasks/gags/street name). Disabled for the first live animation smoke test; re-enable once the animation patches are confirmed.
